title: Integral constant module pushforwards are filtered colimits of finite pushforwards
statement: For integral nu : Y -> X with X Noetherian, finite commutative Lambda and finite Lambda-module M, there are a filtered category I small in universe u, finite X-schemes f_i : Z_i -> X, a diagram D of module sheaves with isomorphisms D_i = f_i,* M_{Z_i}, and a colimit cocone from D to nu_* M_Y [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit].

proof.text:
*Finite approximation of $
u$.* $X$ is Noetherian, hence quasi-compact and quasi-separated, and $
u$ is integral, so by [lem-weil-pbc-integral-morphism-limit-of-finite] $Y=\lim_{i\in I}Y_i$ for a directed inverse system of finite (and finitely presented) $X$-schemes $
u_i:Y_i	o X$ with affine transition morphisms $t_{i'i}$ and projections $p_i:Y	o Y_i$. The morphisms $
u_i$ (finite) and $
u$ (integral) are affine, hence quasi-compact and quasi-separated [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism]. (Stacks: 'we write $Y=\lim Y_i$ with $Y_i$ ... finite over $Z$'; the $Y_i$ there are finite over $Z$, here finite over $X$, which is what the node needs; Stacks' extra 'irreducible, integral' is used only for the 'Moreover' clause, not part of this node.)

proof.text:
*$
u_*\underline M$ is the colimit of the finite pushforwards.* On $Y_i$ take the constant sheaves $\underline M_{Y_i}$, with the transition maps $t_{i'i}^{-1}\underline M_{Y_i}\xrightarrow{\sim}\underline M_{Y_{i'}}$ the canonical isomorphisms of [lemma-constructible-pullback-constant]; then $p_i^{-1}\underline M_{Y_i}\cong\underline M_Y$ compatibly, so $\operatorname{colim}_ip_i^{-1}\underline M_{Y_i}$ is the colimit of a diagram of isomorphisms onto $\underline M_Y$ over the directed (nonempty, connected) set $I$, i.e. $\underline M_Y$. By [sbc-lem-higher-direct-image-limit] in degree $p=0$ (with $S=X$, $g_i=
u_i$, $g=
u$; hypotheses checked in the previous step) the canonical map $\operatorname{colim}_i
u_{i,*}\underline M_{Y_i}	o
u_*\underline M_Y$ is an isomorphism of abelian sheaves; its components are the $\Lambda$-linear maps $
u_{i,*}$(unit$)$ composed with the identifications above, and filtered colimits in $\Mod(X_{\Et},\Lambda)$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit] are computed on underlying abelian sheaves (both are sheafifications of the sectionwise colimit, and a filtered colimit of $\Lambda$-modules is computed on the underlying groups), so $
u_*\underline M_Y=\operatorname{colim}_i
u_{i,*}\underline M_{Y_i}$ in $\Mod(X_{\Et},\Lambda)$. (Stacks: 'Then $f_*\underline E=\colim f_{i,*}\underline E$ by Lemma 09Z1'.) The small cofiltered-category approximation may be replaced by a cofinal directed inverse system to use the directed-poset statement of the relative colimit theorem; finality preserves the resulting colimit. Record the finite stage objects, their direct-image diagram and its colimit cocone; the result does not involve a constructible source F.

theorem exists_filtered_colimit_finite_lowerStar_constant
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] [Finite Λ]
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X]
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} (ν : Y ⟶ X) [IsIntegralHom ν]
    (M : ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) [Finite M] :
    ∃ (I : Type u) (_ : SmallCategory I) (_ : IsFiltered I)
      (Z : I → Scheme.{u}) (f : ∀ i : I, Z i ⟶ X), (∀ i : I, IsFinite (f i)) ∧
      ∃ (D : I ⥤ Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)),
        (∀ i : I, Nonempty (D.obj i ≅ (lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) (f i)).obj
          ((constantSheaf (Z i).smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).obj M))) ∧
        ∃ (η : D ⟶ (Functor.const I).obj
          ((lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) ν).obj
            ((constantSheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).obj M))),
          Nonempty (IsColimit (Cocone.mk _ η))
